title: Multi-Sensor Fusion for UAV Classification Based on Feature Maps of Image and Radar Data
abstract: arXiv:2410.16089v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The cost, flexibility, and efficiency of modern UAVs make them attractive across many applications, but their proliferation has driven a rising number of malicious or accidental incidents, making UAV detection and classification mechanisms essential. Individual sensing modalities each present complementary limitations, and existing detection systems typically rely on a single sensor or fuse modalities only at the decision level, leaving the feature-level fusion of heterogeneous image and radar detectors largely unexplored. We propose a deep neural network that fuses high-level features extracted from the individual object-detection and classification models of thermal, optronic, and radar sensors. A CNN-based architecture combines the three modalities by stacking the thermal and optronic image features along the channel axis prior to fusion with the radar features. tldr: 该论文提出一种深度神经网络，通过基于CNN的架构在特征层面融合热成像、光电图像与雷达三种异构传感器提取的高级特征，从而实现更有效的无人机检测与分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep neural network that performs feature-level fusion of heterogeneous high-level features from thermal, optronic image sensors and radar via a CNN-based architecture, achieving more effective UAV detection and classification.
